name: suffering-jukebox-app
description: Suffering Jukebox native shell - Capacitor web UI + native audio engine (offline, lock screen, CarPlay, Android Auto)

scripts.sync: npm run build:web && LANG=en_US.UTF-8 LC_ALL=en_US.UTF-8 npx cap sync
scripts.ios: npm run sync && npx cap open ios
scripts.android: npm run sync && cap open android
scripts.pods: cd ios/App && LANG=en_US.UTF-8 LC_ALL=en_US.UTF-8 pod install
